    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    await searchbox.fill("How to get rid of unwanted Christmas presents - without being found out")
    search_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for search results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait for dynamic content
    
    # Step 2: Click the link to the target post from search results
    # Assuming the search results contain a link with the exact title

    await target_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the post page to load
    
    # Step 3: Use the knowledge base function to submit a comment
    # Get the current page URL to use in submit_comment_on_page
    current_url = page.url
    # Since the function expects a relative URL, extract the path or use the full URL

    # I'll use the current URL as is, but the function might need a relative path
    # From the tree, links have URLs like '/?p=8', so I'll extract the query part
    import urllib.parse
    parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(current_url)
    page_url = parsed_url.path + '?' + parsed_url.query if parsed_url.query else parsed_url.path
    
    # Call submit_comment_on_page with the required parameters

    )
